detail.title: Chemical Memory to Heredity Transition
detail.question: What experimental evidence distinguishes autocatalytic chemical memory from template-directed heritable information transfer in non-equilibrium systems?
detail.reason: Aligning research effort with the required chemical_heredity focus and investigating the fundamental transition in prebiotic evolution.
